καίπερ concessive particle,
[in LXX: Pro.6:8, Wis.11:9, Jon.1:13, Mac.11 * ;]
although: with ptcp., Php.3:4, Heb.5:8 7:5 12:17, 2Pe.1:12.†

elsewhere.note: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:
though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.
Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them, and are established in the present truth.
